name: Mastercard Agent Pay
status: Commercial programme of Mastercard for agent-initiated payments, described on its framework page (read in a browser on 2026-10-14; first read 2026-10-02). Page metadata: datePublished 2025-10-14, dateModified 2025-11-04. The page introduces the Mastercard Agent Pay Acceptance Framework: registration and verification of agents before they transact with agentic tokens, Web Bot Auth at the content delivery network (CDN) layer, and a Dynamic Token Verification Code, an agentic token formatted for standard card payment fields, submitted in existing checkout forms. The page refers to developer.mastercard.com for use cases; that site was not read.
relevance: The framework page (a Mastercard statement) says "By implementing the emerging Web Bot Auth standard (as outlined in the framework) at the Content Delivery Network (CDN) layer, merchants can verify agent authenticity", and that "we’ve partnered with Cloudflare to support Web Bot Auth in Mastercard Agent Pay". Mastercard is the maintainer of Verifiable Intent (see verifiable-intent).
